name: maat
description: A software engineering team for Claude Code. A Manager (Thoth) conducts the whole loop — intake → plan → build → review → verify → audit → merge-handoff — and is the single voice to you, routing each change to the right specialists by what it touches: architecture, code, network, infra-security, app-security, api-contract, data-model, performance and usability reviewers, plus a standing cross-domain pass, a red team, a design-challenger, an impact-analyst, a test-writer, a debugger, a story-implementer, an intake-refiner and an ADR-amender. Ships as agents, slash commands and skills, with an ADR token-cache that keeps decision records in context cheaply. Works in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.
